claims.evidence: Introduction says FAIR-Data supports end-to-end training and contains15K curated images with labels,source/content tags and rationales. All three named main contributions concern post-training framework, reward distillation and measured improvements. Algorithm1 MoFAIR (visually inspected atp6) takes CoT dataset and training set as inputs and returns an optimized policy; it is not a FAIR-Data curation/provision algorithm despite section4.1 citing it for construction.

claims.claim: Concrete experimental use is documented and distinguished from resource-contribution acceptance.
claims.evidence: FAIR-Data15,000samples split8:1:1 for in-domain evaluation. Table1 MoFAIR accuracy93.7%,AUC0.977,AP0.973; Table2 zero-shotSo-Fake-Set accuracy95.1%,F194.9%. These results support reported method evaluation, not R1 by themselves.
